heads.frontend: 31c3786a6621dea105dea11e7676299900fccd06 (branch release/v2-closeout, clean apart from this untracked verification/ dir)

note: Every finding from reports/09-build-pm-workflows.md and reports/09-audit.md was re-tested in the source at this head. Five are refuted as fixed; eight are confirmed still open.

criteria.evidence: THREE PRIOR FINDINGS ARE REFUTED AS FIXED AT HEAD. F01 (the P0, 'the project budget always says you have spent nothing'): `grep -rn 'hourlyRateMinor|hourly_rate_minor' src/` outside specs now returns only the schema declaration (src/db/schema/build/members.ts:34) and a COMMENT in projects-budget.service.ts:108 explaining why the column is deliberately no longer read. getBudget now costs from the rate stamped on the timesheet entry — `COALESCE(SUM(round(timesheets.hours * timesheets.billRate * 100)) FILTER (WHERE timesheets.billRate IS NOT NULL), 0)` — with voided entries excluded and the double-counting argument written down. F03 ('a 500 on the board or backlog renders a hard 404'): both pages now destructure isError and render ErrorState — project-board-page.tsx:14,30,202 and project-backlog-page.tsx:13,56,63,316, each with a comment saying only the fallback's resolved 404 reaches notFound(). F05's ROLLBACK HALF is refuted by the repo itself: src/modules/automation/__tests__/automation-webhook-log-durability.spec.ts:1-19 shows the only caller (automation.service.ts:171, inside executeAction's try, caught at :250-253) swallows the throw, so the request transaction commits and the webhook_logs rows survive — the double-POST scenario cannot occur. MET CLAUSES: workspace/project/ticket schema (83 build tables, org_id + RLS + policy on all of them, composite (org_id, id) uniques; check:tenant-indexes exit 0); tenant and record authorization (check:tenant-isolation, check:record-access, check:scope-application, check:authz-deny, check:module-entitlement all exit 0 in GATE-STATUS.tsv; resolveProjectAccess walks owner -> permission -> manager -> member -> team); cursor and cache contracts (PAGE_SIZE_CAP=100 clamps rather than 400s; the two-envelope frontend split matches the backend on all six endpoints and must not be 'unified'); folder cohesion (check:cycles, check:import-direction, check:module-di, check:over-300 exit 0).
criteria.blocker: THREE CLAUSES FAIL. (1) BOUNDED BOARDS/BACKLOGS/SEARCH — both defects are unchanged at head. projects-tickets-read.service.ts:340-342 still reads `orderBy === "rank" ? [asc(tickets.rank), asc(tickets.id)] : ...` — a two-key sort against the covering index idx_tickets_org_project_rank_sort (org_id, project_id, rank, created_at DESC, id), so the board's default and only order cannot be served from the index; 09-audit measured 1,850 rows scanned for a 101-row page versus 101 with the three-key order (18.3x), and a deep-page cursor landing as a Filter, not an Index Cond. Note the non-rank branch three lines below ALREADY uses the correct three-key form `[asc(col), desc(tickets.createdAt), asc(tickets.id)]` — only the board path diverges. And projects-search.service.ts:17-31 still selects every projectMembers row for the caller in the org with NO .limit(), maps it to `ids` and feeds the whole array to `inArray(tickets.projectId, ids)` at :50. check:unbounded-reads cannot see either — the second is classified FALSE-POSITIVE, the first has a LIMIT. (2) ASYNC/REALTIME WORKFLOWS — the automation delivery path still runs a provider round trip inside the request's tenant transaction. automation-webhook.service.ts:52-110: `deliverWebhook` does `await fetch(endpoint.url, ..., AbortSignal.timeout(WEBHOOK_TIMEOUT_MS))` and writes webhookLogs on `this.db`, which the tenant-aware proxy resolves to the request transaction; `grep -rn '@NoTenantTransaction' src/modules/automation src/modules/workflows src/modules/build` returns ONE hit and it is inside a spec comment, not a decorator. The endpoint read at :34-37 is now projected but its own comment says 'Deliberately still unbounded', and Promise.allSettled fans out one POST per endpoint with no concurrency cap. The spec header at automation-webhook-log-durability.spec.ts:20-32 concedes both halves are real and that the fix is the outbox path build already implements. (3) REPRESENTATIVE E2E — NOT MET. `find src test -name '*seeded-e2e-spec.ts'` returns 11 files (billing, crm x3, db, kb, perf, security x3, support); NONE covers build, tasks, issues, goals, workflows or automation. The 24 *.e2e-spec.ts in this territory run against the DB-less guard-chain harness (test/helpers/e2e-app.ts:33-47 states it in its own header) and, when pointed at a database at all, at the owner role which has BYPASSRLS — so no tenant policy is ever exercised. `grep -c AUTH_SIGNING_KEYS .env` in the backend returns 0, so they throw out of the box. To close: make the board sort and cursor three-key (or add the (org_id, project_id, rank, id) index), replace the projects-search materialisation with a correlated EXISTS, move automation's delivery onto the outbox path build/core/projects-webhooks-dispatch.service.ts already uses, and add a seeded build-board e2e on a non-owner APP_DATABASE_URL.
criteria.clauses_failing: bounded boards/backlogs/search; async/realtime workflows; representative E2E

criteria.evidence: TWO PRIOR FINDINGS ARE REFUTED AS FIXED AT HEAD. F02 (the retention sweep that 'has never deleted a row and says it succeeded'): cron-outbox-retention.service.ts:86 and :104 now read `WHERE ${eq(outboxEvents.organizationId, orgId)}` and `WHERE ${eq(inboxRecords.organizationId, orgId)}`; the wrong `org_id` survives only in a comment at :58-59 recording that it 'raised 42703 at PARSE time'. And the prior report's own P0 — the durable workflow runtime denied under RLS — holds at head (runInTenantTransaction on every store site, forEachOrg on the sweeps, a per-organisation relay cursor). MET CLAUSES: definition/version/execution schema (nine tables in src/db/schema/common/workflow.ts, all org_id + composite tenant FKs + unique(org_id, id); definition and version genuinely separate, with workflow_executions.workflowVersionId pinning an execution to the version it ran); permission rung (every route under a class-level PermissionGuard + @RequireModule("workflows") with an explicit @RequirePermission; UpdateWorkflowSchema omits 'published' so publishing cannot be reached through the weaker update rung; check:permission-binding exit 0 over 2,384 bindings); retry/DLQ/cancellation (transient-vs-deterministic classifier, dead-letter, cooperative cancellation, every terminal write a compare-and-set on status='running', four dedicated specs); secrets/redaction at rest (AES-256-GCM via encryptSecret which throws when ENCRYPTION_KEY is unset, and SECRET_COLUMNS omits encryptedValue structurally on every read, write and returning).
criteria.blocker: FOUR CLAUSES FAIL. (1) IDEMPOTENT QUEUE/OUTBOX PROCESSING — the weakest dimension and unchanged. The outbox->workflow relay is still UNREACHABLE: `grep -rn 'triggers' src --include='*.ts'` outside specs returns the optional field on WorkflowDefinition (workflow.types.ts:56) and the filter that reads it (workflow-registry.ts:31) and NOTHING ELSE — every registry.register(...) site (workflow.module.ts:40, ingress, crm x2, autonomy, kb, chat, tasks, calendar, expenses, organization) passes `this` or {name, maxAttempts, handler} with no triggers field, so triggeredBy() returns [] for every event type and relay() starts zero runs on every tick. The livelock and starvation defects behind it (CURSOR_LAG=1000 against RELAY_BATCH_SIZE=50 with lifecycle_state never leaving 'ACTIVE'; a fixed organizations.id ASC order spending one 50-event budget) are latent behind that, not fixed. And route-level idempotency is 1 of 18: `grep -n '@Idempotent' src/modules/workflows/workflows.controller.ts` returns exactly line 195 (publish) against 18 @Post/@Patch/@Put/@Delete handlers in the same file, so POST /:workflowId/trigger still inserts a workflow_executions row with no dedupe key. check:idempotent-commands is exit 0 but says nothing about it: /tmp/beg-check_idempotent-commands.log reads 'Controllers scanned 547 / Handlers in scope 11', all 11 are SKIP entries under 'EXCLUDED BY DESIGN', and it then prints 'OK — every in-scope mutating handler carries @Idempotent' over an enforced population of ZERO. (2) BOUNDED EXECUTION HISTORY — met on the wire, unsupported in the index, and NOT MEASURED. `grep -n 'index(' src/db/schema/common/workflow.ts` shows workflow_executions carries only idx_workflow_executions_org_status (org_id, status), idx_workflow_executions_workflow (workflow_id) and idx_workflow_executions_org_created (org_id, created_at) — none leads with (org_id, workflow_id) and carries (created_at, id), which is exactly the keyset listExecutions issues. workflow_executions holds 0 rows in every local database, so no plan can be taken. Same shape at workflow-schedule-tick.service.ts:67-82, where the dueSchedules read still has NO .limit() and the loop below issues its per-schedule round trips sequentially inside one tenant transaction. (3) FRONTEND STATES — three workflow lists silently stop at page 1 at head: hooks/api/workflows-schedules.ts useAllSchedules and hooks/api/workflows-secrets.ts useGlobalSecrets each declare `WorkflowCursorPage<T>` and issue a plain useQuery with no cursor and no second-page fetch, and hooks/api/workflows-variables.ts useGlobalVariables declares a bare `WorkflowVariable[]` against a server-side `.limit(200)` with no hasMore. A tenant past the page size loses rows with no indication. Two features are also unwired rather than defective: workflows.service.ts:98-99 is still `listTemplates() { return Promise.resolve([]); }`, and `grep -rn 'decryptSecret' src --include='*.ts'` outside specs returns five call sites (chat invite links, webhooks dispatch, billing x2) and NONE on workflowSecrets, so a stored workflow secret can never be read by anything. (4) REPRESENTATIVE E2E — NOT MET, same as C123: no *.seeded-e2e-spec.ts covers workflows; workflows.controller.e2e-spec.ts is authorization-shaped only (401/402/403/cross-tenant-404/redaction, no happy path, nothing that creates-publishes-triggers-advances an execution, nothing that calls POST /cron/workflow-tick); it runs DB-less or as the BYPASSRLS owner; and AUTH_SIGNING_KEYS is absent from .env. That single missing test is the one that would have caught the prior P0 and would catch the relay livelock the day a triggers field appears. To close: give the relay a persisted delivery state (the shape outbox-publisher already uses) and real triggers or delete it, add a causation_key + partial unique to workflow_executions for the trigger route, add the (org_id, workflow_id, created_at, id) index, make the three list hooks paginate, and write a seeded workflow-lifecycle e2e that drives the cron tick on a non-owner role.
criteria.clauses_failing: idempotent queue/outbox processing; bounded execution history; frontend states; representative E2E
